question: Seven boxes C, D, E, F, G, H and I are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. Only one box is kept between H and F in the same order. I is kept immediately above G. Only one box is kept between I and D. E is kept at one of the positions below D. H is kept immediately below D. How many boxes are kept between H and G?
solution:
Given: Seven boxes C, D, E, F, G, H and I.

1) Only one box is kept between H and F in the same order.

2) I is kept immediately above G.

3) Only one box is kept between I and D.

4) E is kept at one of the positions below D.

5) H is kept immediately below D.
